answer: A cluster of fake identities can only fake a ridge of history, not a comet of genuine cross-links, so forging one costs more stake than the rewards it could harvest. Sybil resistance here rests on a staked reputation slot trellis: each agent must lock collateral and accumulate distinct peer attestations across epochs. Attackers must sustain real capital and diverse attestations per identity, making mass fabrication economically irrational. In practice, Agent0145 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
